cards.stem: What amount did the United States pay for the land west of the Mississippi River in the 1803 transaction
cards.quote: the United States purchased 828,000 square miles of land west of the Mississippi River for $15 million
cards.hint: Recall the price named in the opening description of the transaction

cards.stem: How much were the negotiators first authorized to pay solely for the port of New Orleans and the Floridas
cards.quote: negotiators Robert Livingston and James Monroe were authorized to pay France up to $10 million solely for the port of New Orleans and the Floridas
cards.hint: Think about the original limit before the larger offer was made

cards.stem: What treaty makes up the Agreement together with two financial conventions
cards.quote: The Louisiana Purchase Agreement is made up of the Treaty of Cession and the two conventions regarding the financial aspects of the transaction.
cards.hint: Look for the name of the formal agreement that transferred the territory

cards.stem: How did the transaction change the overall size of the nation
options: ignored the potential impact on Native Americans
cards.quote: For roughly 4 cents an acre, the United States doubled its size, expanding the nation westward.
cards.hint: Consider the phrase describing the scale of growth after the deal
